channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: This Hyderabad stretch will be named after Donald Trump — This isn't the end
item.description: Telangana is renaming the road housing the US Consulate General in Hyderabad as Donald Trump Avenue, part of a broader push to rebrand key city roads after global leaders and corporations.

item.title: Anant Ambani bags major global animal welfare honour — youngest recipient in award's history
item.description: Anant Ambani has become the youngest and first Asian recipient of the Global Humane Society's top honour for wildlife conservation, recognising his leadership behind India's Vantara initiative.

item.title: Gaurav Khanna lifts BB19 trophy; Farrhana Bhatt wins hearts
item.description: The 19th season of Bigg Boss has concluded with actor Gaurav Khanna lifting the trophy and taking home Rs 50 lakh. Actor Farrhana Bhatt became the first runner-up. Pranit More was the second runner-up; Tanya Mittal and Amaal Mallik got evicted from the Salman Khan-hosted reality show.

item.title: Watch: Rekha pushes female fan asking for selfie at Mumbai airport; netizens compare her to Jaya Bachchan
item.description: On Monday, December 8, Rekha was spotted at the Mumbai airport, exiting the terminal. She waved and smiled for the paparazzi. A female fan rushed towards her with a phone, but the actress gently pushed her away, refusing the picture.

item.title: Trump links tariffs to new farm aid, flags Indian rice imports
item.description: The President framed the new assistance as essential to stabilising the farm economy after what he repeatedly called inherited inflation and depressed commodity prices. "Farmers are an indispensable national asset, part of the backbone of America," he said, arguing that tariff leverage was central to his strategy for reviving US agriculture.

item.title: Indian stock markets open lower amid profit booking
item.description: Sentiment weakened further after reports suggested that US President Donald Trump may consider imposing new tariffs on Indian rice, raising fresh worries about unresolved trade issues between Washington and New Delhi.

item.title: Centre, RBI protecting citizens from exploitation by unauthorised loan apps: Sitharaman
item.description: The government has been constantly engaging with the RBI and other concerned regulators and stakeholders to curb the operations of unauthorised digital loan apps in the country. The Central Bank has operationalised a directory 'Digital Lending Apps (DLAs)' on its website, consisting of all DLAs deployed by regulated entities (REs) of RBI.

item.title: Trump clears conditional NVIDIA H200 sales to China; Warren warns risk
item.description: In a post on Truth Social, Trump said he had "informed President Xi, of China, that the United States will allow NVIDIA to ship its H200 products to approved customers in China, and other Countries, under conditions that allow for continued strong National Security." He added that "President Xi responded positively!"

item.title: Gold, silver open flat ahead of the US Fed policy outcome
item.description: On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), gold February contracts were unchanged at Rs 1,29,978 per 10 grams during early trade. "In the domestic market, MCX Gold (Feb) is trading near Rs 1,29,952, closely tracking the global uptrend while also receiving support from rupee weakness," market experts said.

item.title: IMF approves $1.2 billion for Pakistan; total disbursements stand at $3.3bn
item.description: According to an official release, the IMF Executive Board completed the second review of Pakistan's Extended Fund Facility (EFF) and the first review of its Resilience and Sustainability Facility (RSF), unlocking "about US$1 billion" under the EFF and "about US$200 million" under the RSF. Total disbursements under the two arrangements now stand at "about $3.3 billion."
